description: This file defines the ConfigMapperInterface, an interface for configuration mappers in Drupal's config_translation module, specifying methods for route handling, configuration data, language, and operations.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the translation page.

methods.name: setRouteCollection
methods.description: Sets the route collection for the mapper.

methods.name: getBaseRouteName
methods.description: Returns the name of the base route the mapper is attached to.

methods.name: getBaseRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns route parameters for the base route.

methods.name: getBaseRoute
methods.description: Returns the base route object.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns a processed path for the base route.

methods.name: getOverviewRouteName
methods.description: Returns route name for the translation overview route.

methods.name: getOverviewRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns route parameters for the translation overview route.

methods.name: getOverviewRoute
methods.description: Returns the route object for the translation overview route.

methods.name: getOverviewPath
methods.description: Returns a processed path for the translation overview route.

methods.name: getAddRouteName
methods.description: Returns route name for the translation add form route.

methods.name: getAddRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns route parameters for the translation add form route.

methods.name: getAddRoute
methods.description: Returns the route object for the translation add form route.

methods.name: getEditRouteName
methods.description: Returns route name for the translation edit form route.

methods.name: getEditRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns route parameters for the translation edit form route.

methods.name: getEditRoute
methods.description: Returns the route object for the translation edit form route.

methods.name: getDeleteRouteName
methods.description: Returns route name for the translation deletion route.

methods.name: getDeleteRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns route parameters for the translation deletion route.

methods.name: getDeleteRoute
methods.description: Returns the route object for the translation deletion route.

methods.name: getConfigNames
methods.description: Returns an array of configuration names for the mapper.

methods.name: addConfigName
methods.description: Adds a configuration name to the list.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the mapper.

methods.name: getConfigData
methods.description: Returns all configuration data.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Returns the original language code of the configuration.

methods.name: getLangcodeFromConfig
methods.description: Returns the language code for a specific configuration object.

methods.name: setLangcode
methods.description: Sets the original language code.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data type the mapper encapsulates.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Provides data for building operation links.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the data type the mapper encapsulates.

methods.name: hasSchema
methods.description: Checks if all configuration pieces have a schema.

methods.name: hasTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if configuration pieces have translatables.

methods.name: hasTranslation
methods.description: Checks if there is a translation in a given language.

methods.name: populateFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Populates the mapper with route match data.

methods.name: getContextualLinkGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the contextual link group.
